$comment: The controle remoto's protocol (Rodada G6, PR0): what a phone on the church network may ask the console, checked by electron/lan.cjs, run by the console as its own keys would. Read by main with require() and by pages with import ... with { type: "json" } (like outputNames.json). shared/remoteProtocol.test.mjs keeps it honest against lan.cjs and the live state. Additive only: never rename, retype or remove what an older page reads.

notes.envelope: POST /api/remote with { v: 2, action, args } (no v = a version 1 page; it still works). The body is at most limits.bodyBytes; header x-keryx: 1 and the remote cookie, as in v1. Success: { data: { message (<= limits.message chars), result? } }, result only for the actions that list one in `results`. Refusal: { error: { message, status, code? } }, code one of `codes` (the phone shows message; status 504 = the outcome is unknown, never retried).
notes.args: Each action's args are checked by the server against its `args` schema: enum (values), int (min, max, integers only), bool, id (pattern `idPattern`), str (max chars, trimmed, empty = absent). Unknown keys are dropped; a missing required arg or a wrong type is 400. `oneOf` lists groups of keys of which exactly one is given: the keys of that group marked required must be there and no key of another group may be. The console then checks what the args mean (an id that exists in ITS lists) and refuses in the order 423 (locked) -> 404 (not_found) -> 409 (nothing, missing, syncing, blocked).
notes.kinds: R reads (no log, no toast, no lock check); S puts something on air and is refused with 423 while the screens are locked; T takes something off and works while locked. putsOnAir = kind S = !WHILE_LOCKED.has(op) for every live-state op the action runs (`ops`, or `opsBy` per value of one arg; `kindBy` gives the kind per value of that arg). An action may run ops through others (a send also sets the Fundo, background.set), always of its own kind. player do=swap is T: it takes the video off the projector (media.toAudio); bringing it back (audio.toMedia) puts it on air, so the live state refuses it while locked (423) whatever the kind says.
notes.split: The live state goes to the phone over SSE (/api/events?screen=/Remote): live, hb (every 10 s; stale = nothing for 25 s) and User rows -> header, slides, player position, timer, alert, lock. What only the console knows comes from actions: state on mount, on visible/pageshow/online, when session.itemId, screen or locked change, and every 20 s while visible; library on demand. state is built per request, never pushed (3-6 kB typical, 32 kB at most).
notes.versioning: Additive only: new actions, args, fields and codes; never a rename or a type change. `caps` in state gate the phone's sections (an action whose `cap` is missing is hidden). A changed `app` (the KERYX version) in state reloads the page. An unknown action is 400 and the page shows messages.updateApp. A v1 request (no v) gets the v1 answers: state's `service` is the title string; with v: 2 it is the object { id, title, date }.
notes.privacy: No URL ever comes from the phone but a YouTube link in chat.send / request.send, which the console keeps only as https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id> rebuilt from the id (any other link is 400); answers carry only relative /media/<file> paths (a video's poster as a library row's thumb) and those YouTube links, never a keryx-media:// or another absolute URL.
notes.roles: Two codes sign a phone in (Configurações › Telas na rede › KERYX no celular: one main switch over the two doors, each with its own switch, since 2026-10-27), each with its own cookie, and the code decides the role (Rodada Q). The sign-in page (/lan/remote-code, not this API) also posts role control | team, the side the person picked: the code is then checked against that side alone, so the choice only narrows — the role is still the code's, never the phone's claim (no role = either code, as before). the controle remoto's code is the Controle (role control: the projection) and the Equipe's code the Equipe (role team: chat, song requests, lyrics, the Bíblia and the Setlist to read; it never touches the air or the setlist). An action with team: true is one an Equipe phone may run (teamArgs: the only values it may give those args; teamNeeds: [{ when: { arg: value }, give: [args] }], the args it must also give when one has that value — the library's media only with kind video or audio, never images, PDFs or the whole Mídia, Rodada Q S15); electron/lan.cjs refuses any other with 403 forbidden, and refuses the Controle the actions of cap requests (the Controle has no chat). The console checks the same again. state answers the role: an Equipe phone gets the reduced state (role team, caps teamCaps, what is on air and the Setlist to read, no timers, avisos or lock), the Controle the whole one (caps without requests). An Equipe phone's event stream also hears ServiceMessage changes.
notes.requests: The Equipe's chat and song requests are ServiceMessage rows of the culto chosen on the console (none: today's setlist starts, as the operator's notes do). chat.send and request.send say nothing on the console themselves (its Pedidos tab and toast come from the rows, so a request synced from another computer shows too); the same message again within limits.dedupeMs returns the row already made. Each phone sends at most 3 in a row, then one every 2 s (429 rate). requests reads them a page at a time, never inside state (32 kB).

messages.locked: Telas travadas: nada vai ao ar. Destrave em Saídas.
messages.notInSetlist: Esse item não está mais na setlist.
messages.noFollow: Esta música não tem letra automática.
messages.consoleClosed: O console não está aberto no computador.
messages.rate: Muitos toques seguidos: espere um instante.
messages.busy: O computador está ocupado: tente de novo.
messages.unknownOutcome: Não sei se foi — confira a tela
messages.forbidden: Este código não faz isso no KERYX.

black.label: Tela preta
black.$comment: on omitted = toggle (version 1 pages); on given = idempotent.

logo.label: Logo
logo.$comment: on omitted = toggle (version 1 pages); on given = idempotent.

undo.label: desfez
undo.$comment: Puts back what was on air (the console's Desfazer): many ops, all refused while locked.

bibleSend.label: enviou um versículo
bibleSend.$comment: A chapter alone sends the whole chapter, from verse 1.

player.label: player
player.$comment: layer omitted = the layer the console's player shows; volume in %, to in seconds (seek).

play.label: tocar / pausar
play.$comment: Version 1: the same as player { do: toggle }.

layer.label: camadas
layer.$comment: on false hides (T), true shows (S). corner is the logo in the corner (logo.set visible), which the live state refuses while locked either way: the console answers 423 for it. video is reserved for Camadas' Vídeo layer (the Codex plan, G11); until the console has it, it answers 409 nothing.

setlist.autoplay.label: avançar sozinho
setlist.autoplay.$comment: Setlist automática (Rodada N2): the culto's switch (Service.autoplay), as the Setlist header's. It writes the culto, never the live state (no ops), so it works locked; the console's own watcher then sends nothing while locked. No culto chosen: 409 nothing.

setlist.add.label: adicionou à setlist
setlist.add.$comment: Rodada Q: an item at the end of the culto's Setlist (none chosen: today's starts), as the Biblioteca's drop and the palette's Adicionar. It writes the plan, never the live state (no ops), so it works locked. A passage needs its verses (a chapter alone is 400): it becomes a BiblePassage, never the whole chapter. 404 not_found when the row or the reference does not exist.

request.send.label: pedido de louvor
request.send.$comment: songId: a song of the library the phone listed; one the console no longer has is dropped and the typed song kept. mediaId (Rodada Q, S15): a video or an audio of the Mídia the phone listed; one the console does not have, or of another type, is dropped the same way, and so is any mediaId beside a songId kept.

requests.$comment: skip counts back from the newest: skip 0 is the newest page, its rows oldest first (a chat).

state.app: str: the KERYX version; a change reloads the page
state.caps: str[]: the sections this console can run (see caps)
state.rev: int: changes whenever anything below changes
state.service: { id, title, date } | null (v1 requests: the title string)
state.backItemId: id | null: the item Voltar ao anterior goes back to
state.items: [<= limits.items] { id, title (<= limits.itemTitle), type, section (v1), at, dur, st: ok | missing | syncing | blocked, progress?: str (<= 160) a PDF's pages in the console's words, "Preparando páginas 3/12" or why they failed; only while there is something to say }
state.timers: [<= limits.timers] the timers prontos { id, minutes }: 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 min, then the church's TimerPreset rows (timerPresets.js)
state.alerts: [<= limits.alerts] { id, message (<= limits.alertMessage) }: the AlertPreset rows
state.autoplay: bool: the culto's Avançar sozinho is on (Setlist automática, Rodada N2; setlist.autoplay turns it)
state.role: control | team (Rodada Q): which code signed the phone in. An Equipe phone gets only v, app, caps (teamCaps), role, rev, service, serviceId, onAir, airItemId, items [{ id, title, type, section, songId? (a SONG item's song, for songText; Rodada Q PR4), singer? (who sings, when the item came from a pedido; Rodada Q S13) }] and truncated

library.ready: bool: false while the console's lists are still loading
library.rows: [<= limits.libraryPage] { id, title, sub, dur, fav, st: ok | missing | syncing | blocked, thumb: a relative /media/... poster or null, progress?: str as in state.items }

passage.verses: only for whole: true (the phone's Bíblia, verse by verse): the whole chapter [{ n: int, text: str (<= limits.verseText) }], <= limits.chapterText in all, with truncated: true when it was cut; an older console sends neither, and the phone reads text

end.undo: bool: Desfazer can put it back

send.title: str: what went on air, echoed

added.title: str: the Setlist item made, echoed

sent.id: id: the ServiceMessage row (the one already made, for the same message again within limits.dedupeMs)

requests.total: int: the culto's messages (of that kind)
requests.skip: int: counted back from the newest
requests.rows: [<= limits.requestPage] oldest first { id, at (ISO), kind: chat | pedido, side: team | operator, from, text, singer, song, songId?, mediaId?, media?: video | youtube | audio (the kind of mediaId's row, for its glyph, while the console has it), link?, status: open | done }
requests.side: Rodada Q, S12/S14 (additive): operator = written on the console — a reply in its Chat tab or a pedido it noted with Novo pedido, from "Operador"; team = a phone of the Equipe (rows from before side say team)

songText.title: str
songText.key: str: the song's key (Tom), or empty
songText.parts: [{ name: str (the part's label, empty for none), lines: str[] }] in the order sung, chords inline as the Palco shows them ([G]Grande é o Senhor); cut at limits.stateBytes
